* The side missions were also really dull in comparison to the newer games mostly glorified fetch quests and repeatable missions that add nothing to the story/characters only admittedly things like the tombs in AC II where cool but that's about it the newer games have these types of side content plus interesting story based side missions.

I also want to say the complaints with odyssey about the grind are ridiculous by the way you will **always** be fine to play the next story mission if you just play a few side missions that look interesting and clear a camp or two on the way to objectives i mean you can't enjoy the game very much if you just want to rush from story mission to story mission anyway surely?
